$comment: Hobby box products only. No retail configurations. estimatedValue is measured by tools/simulate.mjs.

boxes.name: Optic Elite Football
guarantees: 2 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
8 numbered parallels per box (avg)
boxes.blurb: The gateway hobby box. Bright optical chrome stock, a deep rookie checklist and two guaranteed hits.

boxes.name: Vertex Select Football
guarantees: 3 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
Tri-level checklist: Concourse / Premier / Field Level
boxes.blurb: Three checklist tiers stacked into one box. Premier and Field Level rookies carry the case.

boxes.name: Spectra Prizm Football
guarantees: 3 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
144 cards - the deepest silver run in the hobby
boxes.blurb: The flagship. 144 cards per box and the silver parallel that defines the modern rookie market.

boxes.name: Sovereign Treasures Football
guarantees: 5 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
Every card numbered to 99 or lower
boxes.blurb: Museum-grade stock, oversized patches and on-card rookie signatures. Everything inside is numbered.

boxes.name: Flawless Gridiron
guarantees: 7 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
Diamond-embedded base cards
boxes.blurb: Two packs. Twenty cards. Nothing common. The most expensive sealed product on the shelf.

boxes.name: Optic Elite Basketball
guarantees: 2 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
Rated Rookie subset
boxes.blurb: Hardwood's entry point. Rated Rookies on optical chrome with two guaranteed hits.

boxes.name: Vertex Select Basketball
guarantees: 3 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
Courtside / Premier / Concourse tiers
boxes.blurb: Tiered checklist, die-cut Courtside rookies and three hits a box.

boxes.name: Spectra Prizm Basketball
guarantees: 3 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
Silver Prizm rookie run
boxes.blurb: The basketball flagship. The silver rookie card that sets the market for a whole draft class.

boxes.name: Sovereign Treasures Basketball
guarantees: 5 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
Every card numbered to 99 or lower
boxes.blurb: Thick stock, jumbo prime patches and the rookie patch autograph the whole hobby chases.

boxes.name: Flawless Hardwood
guarantees: 7 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
Diamond-embedded base cards
boxes.blurb: Gem-set luxury. Twenty cards, every one of them a hit or a numbered parallel.

boxes.name: Prospect Chrome Baseball
guarantees: 2 autographs per box
1st Bowman prospect checklist
boxes.blurb: The prospecting box. Nearly every card is a first-year prospect. Buy the future, wait five years.

boxes.name: Apex Chrome Baseball
guarantees: 2 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
24 packs - the longest hobby box on the shelf
boxes.blurb: Twenty-four packs of chrome. The rookie card collectors still buy a decade later.

boxes.name: Finest Edition Baseball
guarantees: 2 autographs or memorabilia cards per box
Refractor-heavy configuration
boxes.blurb: Mirror-finish stock and the highest refractor rate of any baseball hobby box.
